newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm oil little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm oil little changed in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian crude palm oil (CPO) and olein prices were little changed in slow late trading, traders said on Thursday.
One trader in Medan said no CPO tender was scheduled for this week because of the prevailing low prices. He said the market was quiet on a lack of fresh leads.
Traders said buying interest for CPO remained at around 1,190 rupiah/kg. It was offered at around 1,200 rupiah/kg.
One said retail olein price in Medan recovered to 1,390 rupiah/kg, compared with an early price of 1,375 rupiah/kg following a firmer price in Jakarta and Surabaya.
He said prices seemed to have a hit the bottom for now because of relatively tight supply in the market.
Ready olein was quoted at around 1,450 rupiah/kg in Jakarta and 1,470 rupiah/kg in Surabaya.
Olein for October delivery was quoted at 1,425 rupiah/kg in Jakarta.
